documents_expected.why: Program/Project grants page: eligibility, amounts, cap, cycle, reports
quick reference: range, one grant per year, report deadline
who can apply; new applicants make a portal account

eligibility.rule: Established 501(c)(3) organisation, or a 501(c)(3) fiscal agent
eligibility.quote: Applicants must be established, well managed 501(c)(3) organizations - or have a 501(c)(3) fiscal agent.

eligibility.rule: Programmes must serve Montana or the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem
eligibility.quote: Applicants must operate effective programs that serve Montana or the Greater Yellowstone Ecosystem.

eligibility.rule: Grant is $2,500–$15,000 and at most 50% of the project budget
eligibility.quote: grant amounts will range from $2,500 - $15,000, and not exceed 50% of the total project budget, whichever is less.

eligibility.rule: Only one grant application per year
eligibility.quote: Applicants can apply for only one grant per year.

eligibility.rule: 2026 grantees must have filed their report
eligibility.quote: An applicant organization that received a grant in 2026 must submit an interim / final report

documents.item: Online application in the grant portal
documents.quote: Only online applications will be accepted.

documents.item: Fiscal agent letter confirming sponsorship and 501(c)(3) status, if using a fiscal agent
documents.quote: a letter from the fiscal agent confirming sponsorship of the project and 501(c)(3) status must accompany the application.

effort.step: Create a portal account if you have never had a Cinnabar grant
effort.quote: IF YOU HAVE NOT RECEIVED A CINNABAR FOUNDATION GRANT, YOU WILL NEED TO CREATE A "NEW ACCOUNT" TO APPLY.
The 2027 Grant application cycle will be open from Jan 11 - Feb 19, 2027. Late submissions will not be accepted under any circumstances.

co_finance_required.quote: grant amounts will range from $2,500 - $15,000, and not exceed 50% of the total project budget, whichever is less.

after_award.quote: An applicant organization that received a grant in 2026 must submit an interim / final report describing the progress made toward achieving the purposes outlined in the applicant's grant application and detailing expenditures made from the granted funds.

notes: Ambiguous for adjudication: the page also says 'Organizations are not required to match Cinnabar funding', yet the grant may not exceed 50% of the project budget (and rarely exceeds 25%), so half the budget must come from elsewhere; recorded as co-finance by the same rule as other grant caps. The page says to review the application form and instructions 'linked below', but no such links are on the page. General Operating grants are by invitation only. For 2027 grants the initial report is due 31 January 2028.
